status: development figures beside the negotiation bar, never inside it and never a claim; read at call time by tools/score_neg_advisor.py dev-figures and tune-threshold
conflict_margin_threshold_note: D-756 item 3 (P3): a proposal's conflict is decided by this one threshold on the largest oppose margin among the persona's positions on it (the margin of a stance step is its probability of oppose minus the largest probability of another declared stance, from the step's saved choice decision): conflict when that largest margin is at or above the threshold or a red line was answered yes, else no_conflict; an accept or reject stance follows the conflict, a counter is kept. Null until tuned: tune-threshold picks a value on a declared split of item ids that does not overlap the deciding set, and the value is written here by the lead under a decision id before the deciding read. One value, never per structure or per set.
position_oppose_note: D-756 item 2 (N1): oppose recall and precision over every (proposal, position) pair the mapping puts on a proposal, against the stances of the set's build files, with item-clustered BCa intervals; a pair the chain did not judge counts as a miss for recall and is not a prediction for precision. Reported beside the bar, never inside it.
article_proposal_link_note: D-758 (Seckin 22:15): when true, the system's composition step (tools/score_neg_advisor.py system_python, in score and dev-figures, and the N1 units) reads each article-level position (proposal null) whose declared article holds exactly one proposal as on that proposal, from structure alone (no stance, quote, word, label or key read); a position with no article, an article outside the excerpt, an article with no proposal or with several proposals is not linked and is counted by that reason. Scoring keeps the item as built. Development only, measured on the old pilot and one other validation set.
audit_unsupported_kept_note: D-878 (AM-4, 21 November 2026): when true, tools/score_neg_advisor.py keeps a piece the system's audit alone calls unsupported as the system wrote it, marked audit: unsupported (HONEST-OUTPUT-A), instead of withholding it as no_answer; a piece a system-mode check refuses is withheld either way. Declared ex ante for the next negotiation round on items not yet seen: the lead sets it true under a decision id before that round's deciding read; the withheld reading is scored beside it from the same replies. False for every figure already reported. Set true on 21 November 2026 under D-889, before any round 4 reading (D-888); every figure before it was scored with false.
open_stance_m4_note: D-888 (round 4): when true, tools/score_neg_advisor.py item_parts compares a piece carrying the stance kind open (the stepwise switch open_stance, benchmark/baselines/neg_advisor.py) with the key's open fate in M4 (open with open) and scores the open fate rows; every other fate keeps its comparison (kept with accept, changed with counter, removed with reject; an open-kind piece on a changed fate is a miss). False for every round already reported; the lead sets it true under a decision id before round 4's deciding read. Set true on 21 November 2026 under D-891, before any round 4 reading (D-888); every earlier figure was scored with false. 21 Nov 2026 D-919: off again, round 4 not adopted (D-914).
